name: Titan, Meggidon
body:
TITAN, MEGGIDON
CR 23

XP 819,200
NE Colossal outsider (extraplanar, evil, psionic)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 120 ft., pierce the veils; Perception +35

DEFENSE

AC 40, touch 2, flat-footed 40 (+38 natural, –8 size)
hp 471 (23d10+345); regeneration 15 (epic)
Fort +28, Ref +7, Will +22; +11 resistance vs. mind-affecting effects
DR 15/adamantine or DR 10/good; Immune ability score damage, aging, blindness, critical hits, deafness, death effects, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning; PR 34

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee 2 +5 unarmed strikes +40 or +38/+38/+33/+33/+28/+28/+23 (4d6+25+1d6 energy damage)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks psionic fist +2, trample (4d6+30, DC 41)
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 20th; concentration +28)

Constant—body of iron, claw of energy, energy retort (DC 21), metaphysical claw, personal barred mind, pierce the veils
At will—awestrike*, energy burst (20d6, DC 28), stomp (20d4, DC 28)
3/day—fold space (move action), psychofeedback (1 minute/level, fades on expiration), slip the bonds
1/day—timeless body, shockwave*

TACTICS

Without body of iron active, the meggidon titan’s statistics are Init +7, AC 43, touch 5, flat-footed 40; Ref +10; DR 10/good; Immune aging, death effects, disease; Speed 100 ft., Melee 2 +5 unarmed strikes +37 or +35/+35/+30/+30/+25/+25/+20 (4d6+22+1d6 energy damage), Str 45, Dex 16; CMB +48, CMD 61

STATISTICS

Str 51, Dex 10, Con 41, Int 20, Wis 28, Cha 26
Base Atk +23; CMB +51; CMD 61
Feats Double Slice, Greater Psionic Fist, Greater Two-Weapon Fighting, Improved Initiative, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack, Psionic Fist, Pummeling Charge, Pummeling Style, Two-Weapon Fighting, Unavoidable Strike Skills Craft (mechanical) +31, Intimidate +34, Knowledge (arcana) +31, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +31, Knowledge (engineering) +31, Knowledge (history) +31, Knowledge (nature) +31, Knowledge (planes) +31, Perception +35, Sense Motive +35, Spellcraft +31
Languages Abyssal, Aklo, Infernal, Synthic, +2 others; telepathy 300 ft.
SQ explosive change shape (see text)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Explosive Change Shape (Su)

A meggidon titan has a specific form at each size from Small to Colossal and can alternate between any of these forms as a standard action. The same basic shape and abilities of the titan are retained, causing ability scores and other traits not to be altered when the titan is in their reduced size. When changing shape, a meggidon can manifest energy burst as part of the same action.

ABOUT

Possessing immense psionic control over their bodies, the tremendous meggidon titans are said to reweave their muscles with every step taken and every blow thrown. Every sinew in their body ripples beneath unbreaking skin which glistens in a rainbow of colors. As each meggidon is constructed of countless souls, it is thought that every cell in its body is piloted by a unique mind trained over centuries to fight as a unit.
